The image shows the reddish-brown polished wood grain of the instrument's body (likely the boot or wing joint). Visible features include silver-plated metal keys, rods, and key guards attached to the wood. A portion of the bell flare is visible at the very top edge. The background is a neutral, textured grey fabric.

selected_experts.reason: Primary verification that the visual features (wood grain, key mechanics) align with the specific class 'bassoon' and not a generic woodwind or AI hallucination.
To detect subtle texture anomalies in the wood grain or metal reflections that might indicate AI generation artifacts like smearing or inconsistent lighting.
To ensure the complex mechanical parts (keys, rods, screws) are physically connected to the wood body without floating elements or fusion artifacts common in AI generations of intricate machinery.

focus_areas: Mechanical plausibility of key mounts and rods
Lighting consistency on metal vs. wood surfaces
Edge sharpness between keys and background
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the intersection of the metal keys and the wood. AI often struggles with the precise mechanical attachment points (screws/posts). Verify if the wood grain wraps naturally around the cylindrical form or if it looks like a flat texture map. Check for any 'melting' of the thin metal rods into the background or the wood body.
